curatedMovie.curiosityHook: As Elizabeth trades her old memories for stops in unfamiliar diners, will the strangers she meets offer genuine answers or simply deepen her longing?
curatedMovie.description: Reeling from a painful breakup, Elizabeth leaves her familiar life behind to travel across America, taking waitress shifts and crossing paths with other restless souls whose turmoil mirrors and clarifies her own.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A slow, emotionally heavy road drama with an engaged and thoughtful tone, best suited for reflective solo watching.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Director Wong Kar-Wai crafts an intimate romantic drama driven by melancholic encounters, patient pacing, and the slow accumulation of insight that follows heartbreak on the road.
